item.title: Replicating Telegram's AI Editor
item.author: kuqilin@outlook.com (Kuqilin)
item.description:
Replicating Telegram's AI Editor

Author: Kuqilin(kuqilin@outlook.com)

This article collects and integrates multiple community-recreated Telegram AI editor prompts, covering all six official styles plus the emoji transformation feature. The individual versions section provides eight standalone prompts, each strictly mimicking Cocoon AI’s rewriting logic — outputting only the body text, preserving core information, and never altering the original meaning. The unified version merges all styles into a single prompt, allowing you to switch between different writing styles within a single conversation by entering a style keyword.

Published on 2026-07-15 at Kuqilin's Blog, last modified on 2026-07-15
